ov: An African monkey with a black face and grey body hair, living in groups of 10 to 70. It is best known for its alarm calls: each of its predators, from leopards to eagles and pythons, sets off a different call.
len: Males 42–60 cm, females 30–49.5 cm (head and body)
rg: Southern and East Africa, from Ethiopia and southern South Sudan down to South Africa.
df: Mostly plants: wild fruit, flowers, leaves, seeds and pods, plus grasshoppers and termites.
fx: Young vervets learn the different alarm calls just by watching the adults.
Many farmers see them as pests because they raid bean, pea, fruit and grain crops.
_t: Is a Vervet Monkey Dangerous? Diet, Size & Quick Facts
